name: Supplemental Catalog Synthesis
description: On a timer, reads the stored $OMM records (typed storage.query) - our OD-fitted supplemental OMMs (analysis/od/fit-pipeline, stored under the provider's SOURCE_NAME) and Space-Track GP (stored under a Space-Track source name) - and merges them into ONE canonical CelesTrak-replacement OMM catalog (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only). Deterministic per-NORAD precedence: a provider's fitted OMM wins over Space-Track GP only when the provider is at gate level hard-pass AND the fit is strictly fresher (epoch); otherwise Space-Track GP. An object present in either lane is never dropped; objects with no NORAD are quarantined, never keyed as NORAD 0. Each catalog record is the winning stored $OMM byte for byte (its CID is the winner's); the decision is one $CAT per object (PRODUCTS[0]: KIND Sgp4Elements or Sgp4XpElements by the set's theory, RECORD_CID the winner's CID, SOURCE_ID the winning source name, EPOCH, SELECTION_REASON the precedence rule); the batch goes out as an IngestRequest plus a size-prefixed $OMM record stream for hostcap/storage-ingest (storing and publishing are the flow's) and the size-prefixed $CAT stream. Gate status is data: config/provider-gate-status.json compiled in, overridden by node config (plugin.getConfig). Deterministic: no wall clock, batch_id = sha256 of the sorted input CIDs, NORADs ascending.

timers.description: Periodic catalog synthesis pass over stored OMM records (default every 6h, matching the Space-Track current-gp poll cadence - no value re-synthesizing faster than the newest inputs refresh).

methods.description: One pass: storage.query(querySchema, queryLimit) -> classify each stored $OMM by its SOURCE_NAME (a spacetrackSourceNames entry or untagged: Space-Track GP; any other: our fit of that provider) -> per NORAD the newest record of each lane, then precedence (ours-hardpass-fresher, spacetrack-ours-gate-<level>, spacetrack-ours-not-fresher, ours-sole-source-gate-<level>, spacetrack-sole-source) -> omm_meta + omm_records; counts, quarantine and unreadable records are FlowNotices. Node config (plugin.getConfig): querySchema, queryLimit, sourceName, fileIdPrefix, dataSource, spacetrackSourceNames, defaultLevelForUnlistedProvider, gateStatus {providers, spacetrackSourceNames, defaultLevelForUnlistedProvider}.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK); FIRED_MS stamps the notices.

inputPorts.description: The catalog-synthesis-pull timer tick; a direct invoke needs none.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The catalog batch's IngestRequest for hostcap/storage-ingest: SCHEMA OMM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID and SOURCE_NAME the synthesis identity (config sourceName, default catalog-synthesis), BATCH_ID the batch_id, SOURCE_URL sdn://catalog-synthesis, RECONCILE None, PROVENANCE counts and attributes. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

outputPorts.description: The catalog batch's IngestRequest for hostcap/storage-ingest: SCHEMA OMM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID and SOURCE_NAME the synthesis identity (config sourceName, default catalog-synthesis), BATCH_ID the batch_id, SOURCE_URL sdn://catalog-synthesis, RECONCILE None, PROVENANCE counts and attributes. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The catalog as ONE size-prefixed $OMM record stream, ascending NORAD: each the winning stored $OMM, byte for byte. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

outputPorts.description: The catalog as ONE size-prefixed $OMM record stream, ascending NORAD: each the winning stored $OMM, byte for byte. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The decision as ONE size-prefixed $CAT record stream, ascending NORAD, one per catalog record: OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_ID, NORAD_CAT_ID of the winner, OWNER UNK, PRODUCTS[0] KIND (Sgp4Elements or Sgp4XpElements by the winner's MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY), RECORD_CID the winner's stored CID, SOURCE_ID the winning source name, EPOCH the winner's, SELECTION_REASON the precedence rule. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

outputPorts.description: The decision as ONE size-prefixed $CAT record stream, ascending NORAD, one per catalog record: OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_ID, NORAD_CAT_ID of the winner, OWNER UNK, PRODUCTS[0] KIND (Sgp4Elements or Sgp4XpElements by the winner's MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY), RECORD_CID the winner's stored CID, SOURCE_ID the winning source name, EPOCH the winner's, SELECTION_REASON the precedence rule. Nothing when the catalog is empty.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotices. Info: the summary (COUNT catalog records, REASON ours-won / spacetrack-won / quarantined / unreadable counts) and one per provider (SOURCE_NAME the provider, COUNT won). Skipped: the quarantined records (REASON no-norad-unmapped-object-id, ITEMS their CIDs) and the unreadable ones (REASON unreadable, ITEMS <reason>:<cid>, reason unknown-encoding, malformed-flatbuffer-omm or missing-epoch). Missing: storage.query failed (REASON storage-query-failed: <message>).

outputPorts.description: FlowNotices. Info: the summary (COUNT catalog records, REASON ours-won / spacetrack-won / quarantined / unreadable counts) and one per provider (SOURCE_NAME the provider, COUNT won). Skipped: the quarantined records (REASON no-norad-unmapped-object-id, ITEMS their CIDs) and the unreadable ones (REASON unreadable, ITEMS <reason>:<cid>, reason unknown-encoding, malformed-flatbuffer-omm or missing-epoch). Missing: storage.query failed (REASON storage-query-failed: <message>).

sequentialJustification.detail: One pass reads the stored records, merges them and emits the catalog on the calling thread; nothing is spawned and nothing is shared between passes.
